columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Exchange rate type for late charges.Validated against the table GL_DAILY_CONVERSION_TYPES. The type USER is excluded.

columns.name: MIN_FC_INVOICE_OVERDUE_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates whether the minimum invoice balance overdue is expressed as a fixed amount or a percentage

columns.name: MIN_FC_INVOICE_PERCENT
columns.description: Invoice balance threshold percentage below which late charges can not be charged

columns.name: MIN_FC_BALANCE_OVERDUE_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates whether the minimum customer balance amount overdue is expressed as a fixed amount or a percentage

columns.name: MIN_FC_BALANCE_PERCENT
columns.description: Customer balance percentage threshold below which the late charge cannot be charged

columns.name: INTEREST_TYPE
columns.description: Refers to the interest portion of the charge to be calculated on late invoices. Can be a fixed amount, a percentage or based on a charges schedule. Validated against lookup type AR_INTEREST_PENALTY_TYPE.

columns.name: INTEREST_FIXED_AMOUNT
columns.description: The flat amount to be charged on all overdue invoices. Used when interest type is fixed amount

columns.name: INTEREST_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Charge based on a tiered schedule. Used when interest type is charges schedule. Foreign key to AR_CHARGES_SCHEDULES.SCHEDULE_ID

columns.name: PENALTY_TYPE
columns.description: Refers to any additional penalties to be added to late charges. Can be a fixed amount, a percentage or based on a charges schedule.  Validated against lookup type AR_INTEREST_PENALTY_TYPE.

columns.name: PENALTY_RATE
columns.description: The penalty will be calculated as a fixed percentage of the late charge. Used when penalty type is  percentage.

columns.name: MIN_INTEREST_CHARGE
columns.description: Threshold amount below which late charge must not be charged.

columns.name: PENALTY_FIXED_AMOUNT
columns.description: The penalty will be a flat fee applied to the late charge. Used when penalty type is fixed amount.

columns.name: PENALTY_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Charge based on a tiered schedule. Used when penalty type is charges schedule. Foreign key to AR_CHARGES_SCHEDULES.SCHEDULE_I

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: AUTOCASH_TOLERANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Maximum amount in the business unit ledger currency to apply to the difference between the receipt amount and the open balance amount.
